p: me: He desires God to undertake his cause against the enemies but chiefly that he would restore him to the tabernacle.
nation: That is, the cruel company of my enemies.
light and thy truth: That is, your favour which appears by the performance of your promises.
will I go unto the altar: He promises to offer a solemn sacrifice of thanksgiving in token of his great deliverance.
hope in God: By which he admonishes the faithful not to relent but constantly to wait on the Lord, though their troubles are long and great.
